shared_elements: massive frontal anthropomorphic figure carved in the round from a single block
large elaborate head/headdress element dominating the upper part
incised parallel-line detailing (feather- or hair-like grooves) on the head element
blocky, squat body proportions with arms folded/held against the torso
vertical stacking of head above body above base
justification: Both depict a single squat, heavy-set anthropomorphic being whose head region is enlarged by an elaborate headdress-like mass covered in incised parallel grooves, with a compact body below and arms brought in against the torso, rendered in a schematic, block-bound manner. The clearest difference is that A presents a flat, frontal stela-like figure whose torso carries distinct low-relief insignia (a central disc pectoral, a belt band, scroll motifs) laid out in registers, while B is a fully three-dimensional composite figure with no comparable emblematic devices on the body and a strongly projecting beaked/zoomorphic upper mass.
